text: Ai Hayasaka
{character:Ai Hayasaka}Oh my, the points are tied. What's the verdict, Mr. President?
Looks like Mai Aihara's prayer blessed Miyuki, too. Miyuki successfully clawed his way back during the South Wind round and tied with Kaguya upon concluding the Hanchan.
Miyuki Shirogane
{character:Miyuki Shirogane}How about another game of Hanchan?
Kei Shirogane
{character:Kei Shirogane}Kei Shirogane: Don't even dream of it! Your shift is up, you fool. Miss Kaguya, if you wanna play, I'll replace him.
Kaguya Shinomiya
{character:Kaguya Shinomiya}Sorry, Kei, but I'm kinda tired. I think it's time for me to head out. We should play next time if we get the chance.
{character:Kei Shirogane}Oh well...
{character:Kaguya Shinomiya}If you have time, stop by the student council. I'll ask Secretary Fujiwara to set up some Mahjong games.
{character:Kei Shirogane}Miss Shinomiya... It's a deal!
{character:Kaguya Shinomiya}A promise is a promise. Since I didn't win against you, Mr. President, I guess I have no power to keep you from your job.
{character:Miyuki Shirogane}Speaking of which, this was an odd demand to begin with. Shinomiya, why are you not supportive of me working here?
{character:Kaguya Shinomiya}The bet is closed. No point in dwelling on it.
{character:Miyuki Shirogane}Come on. I was sweating bullets almost the entire day. You could at least tell me why...
Ichihime
{character:Ichihime}Well, Kaguya, you might not have won the game, but today is the last day for the Shirogane siblings to work here, anyway, nyaa.
{character:Kaguya Shinomiya}Huh? Is that so?
{character:Miyuki Shirogane}Huh?! Manager Ichihime, I thought we still had one week left?
{character:Ichihime}Don't make me repeat myself. Ichihime is a goddess, not your manager, nyaa. Something came up, so the event has to be cut short, nyaa.
{character:Miyuki Shirogane}Crap... It's gonna be super hard to find something so well-paid again...
{character:Ichihime}Nyaa nyaa nyaa, don't be sad, nyaa. Rest assured, since you and Kei are a hardworking duo, you will be paid handsomely. Besides, I have a gift for you.
{character:Ichihime}Do you still remember my words, nyaa? As long as you are diligent, Ichihime shall make one of your wishes come true.
{character:Miyuki Shirogane}I think I can vaguely remember that. But isn't that a joke...? No way. Aren't those on my wish list...?

Miyuki unpacks a bag handed over by Ichihime. It is full of the French learning books he always wanted to buy. As these books are exorbitant, Miyuki passed by the bookstore several times without buying them.
The books also manage to catch Kaguya's attention.
{character:Kaguya Shinomiya} (French... Reference books...)

{character:Ichihime}Miyuki, didn't you say that you always wanted to be fluent in French? This is my parting gift for you, nyaa! Please don't tell me that learning it by yourself is troublesome. If you want to master it, you've gotta walk the talk, nyaa.
{character:Miyuki Shirogane}...Sound advice, Goddess Ichihime. I second that one has to work hard in everything! I'm truly grateful!
{character:Ichihime}(Nya hmph! Here's a complementary piece of advice with the gift. Take this and ask for your crush's help. This is the perfect way to get closer with each other, nyaa!)
{character:Miyuki Shirogane}(That... That won't work... If I ask for her help, she will...)
{character:Kaguya Shinomiya}Oh my, does Mr. President want to learn French because both Secretary Fujiwara and I speak fluent French?
{character:Kaguya Shinomiya}Mr. President is so indomitable... How cute.
{character:Miyuki Shirogane}(She'll definitely say something like that...)
{character:Ichihime}I'm surprised that you're actually pretty shy. Well, I can always ask on your behalf, nyaa!
{character:Miyuki Shirogane}No, just no! Please don't ask Kaguya... Huh? Where did they go?

{character:Kei Shirogane}They left while you two were busy whispering to each other. By the way, why are you blushing, brother? That's gross! Now scram! I can't entertain my guests with you getting in the way!
{character:Ai Hayasaka}...My lady. Looks like you're in a good mood.
{character:Kaguya Shinomiya}Shush, Hayasaka. You must be tripping.
{character:Kaguya Shinomiya}(Mr. President worked so hard just to fulfill that dream? I wouldn't have interfered if I'd known what was happening.)

{character:Kaguya Shinomiya} (I'll find the perfect opportunity to guide him. Then his impression of me will improve, and that will be the golden opportunity for him to confess to me! Salute, Goddess with cat ears!)
Everybody is satisfied with how things turned out at the shrine.
And everybody is a winner today.
Miyuki Shirogane got his reference books and paycheck.
Meanwhile, Kaguya Shinomiya has everything planned for the future.
And the Mahjong Soul Shrine has completed the test for the new set of rules.
Everything has fallen into place. How joyful!
